latest_release.body:
> [!CAUTION]
> This release includes mitigations for the recent [eMudhra CA compromise](https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/) as well as general dependency upgrades. While we don't believe RomM instances are vulnerable, we recommend upgrading as soon as possible.

## What's Changed
* docs(readme): move corporate sponsors above friends by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5219
* chore(deps-dev): bump handlebars from 4.7.9 to 4.7.10 in /frontend by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5221
* fix(deps): bump certifi to 2026.10.19 to distrust compromised eMudhra intermediates by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5283
* chore(deps): bump uv to 0.13.4 by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5284
* chore(trunk): Upgrade trunk by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5225
* chore(deps): update github actions by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5244
* chore(deps): bump aiohttp from 3.14.3 to 3.14.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5276
* chore(deps-dev): bump vite from 8.3.1 to 8.3.4 in /frontend by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5285
* chore(deps): bump follow-redirects from 1.16.0 to 1.16.1 in /frontend by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5286
* docs: list the ROM patcher env vars in env.template by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5265
* chore(deps): update dependency pillow to v13 [security] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5288
* chore(deps): update dependency storybook to v10.6.2 [security] by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5291
* chore(deps): bump Node to 24.22.1 for the October 2026 security release by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5295
* fix(docker): upgrade the image's pip to 26.2.2 by @gantoine in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5298
* chore(deps): update github/codeql-action action to v4.39.0 by @renovate[bot] in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5299

## New Contributors
* @pcbeingused333 made their first contribution in https://github.com/rommapp/romm/pull/5265

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rommapp/romm/compare/5.4.0...5.4.1
